i. Sandipan Dey, Hands-On Generative AI with Transformers and Diffusion Models, Packt, 2023
ii. Dhamani, Numa, and Maggie Engler, Introduction to Generative AI, Manning Publications, 2023
iii. David Foster, Generative Deep Learning: Teaching Machines to Paint, Write, Compose, and Play,

5. Outcome of the Course:
The student will learn about the fundamentals of Generative AI, including various models, 
architectures, and their applications. They will gain practical experience in building, fine-tuning, and 
deploying generative models, as well as understanding ethical considerations and real-world case 
studies.
